title: The Paradise of the Devil, Paperback
description:
A coup in Cuba. A buried secret. A nation on the brink.

A Cuban colonel, disillusioned with the state of his country’s military, confronts Castro, kills him, and takes command of the island. He expects the Cuban people to support his takeover. Instead, a civilian army rises against his troops. As the struggle for control intensifies, a secret left over from the Cuban Missile Crisis draws the United States into a confrontation with consequences far beyond Cuba.

title: The Vulture Will Lead You to Death, Paperback
description:
At the Port of Miami, one attack could change everything.

Terrorists enter the United States from Cuba with a plan to strike the Port of Miami. They know a supertanker is docked at the seaport and intend to turn it into a devastating target. What they do not know is that a massive ship carrying military supplies is stationed nearby. Its presence could magnify the destruction, turning an already deadly attack into a far greater catastrophe.

title: The Vector, Paperback
description:
Eight operatives. Eight cities. A threat without borders.

In this geopolitical thriller, Iran responds to war with a covert biological attack on the United States. Eight volunteers are fitted with false teeth containing a deadly agent and sent through Mexico toward eight American cities. Their orders are to release the agent and spread the infection before it kills them. The novel follows the threat of an attack carried by people rather than conventional weapons.

title: The Warning of Ramses, Paperback
description:
When the Nile stops flowing, the world moves toward war.

Egypt’s dependence on the Nile becomes the fault line of an international conflict. When Ethiopia builds a dam on the Blue Nile and sharply reduces the water reaching Egypt, the dispute moves toward war. Joined by Libyan forces, Egypt confronts Ethiopia and the United States over the project. A struggle over a river becomes a crisis with consequences across the region.

title: IFF: Identify Friend or Foe, Paperback
description:
The system built to protect them becomes their greatest vulnerability.

An Iranian pilot steals an F-18 and turns it against an American aircraft carrier in the Persian Gulf. In the novel’s central premise, the aircraft’s friendly identification signal becomes a dangerous vulnerability: the systems designed to prevent friendly fire also obstruct the fleet’s response to an enemy flying one of its own aircraft. A safeguard intended to save lives becomes the opening for a devastating attack.

title: God’s Sword of Justice, Paperback
description:
A nuclear reactor. A narrowing window. An impossible mission.

Terrorists seize the control room of the Indian Point nuclear power plant in New York and shut off cooling water to the reactor. The novel places the facility within a nine-hour window before a catastrophic meltdown, with the surrounding region facing long-term contamination. Walker’s elite soldiers must stop the attackers before their plan turns a nuclear facility into a weapon.

title: Operation Glass Slipper, Paperback
description:
A discovery that could heal the atmosphere—or become a weapon.

A doctor discovers a microbe that survives by consuming carbon in crude oil. Working with a microbiologist, he alters it so it can travel through the air and consume the carbon polluting the atmosphere. The discovery promises an extraordinary environmental benefit. But a small group of terrorists sees a different possibility and seeks to exploit the research in the development of a biological weapon.

title: Operation Dragon Fire, Paperback
description:
A series of attacks conceals a far more dangerous objective.

An Iraqi terrorist, admitted to the United States after helping American troops, recruits a group for a series of coordinated attacks. Targets in New York and Washington are intended to conceal a more dangerous objective: a nuclear strike between the White House and the Capitol. The specialized Dragon Fire troops are called upon to stop a plan built around distraction, timing, and escalating threats.

title: Bio-Level Three, Paperback
description:
Deep in the desert, a secret must be stopped before it goes live.

A rebel-led Libyan military command is secretly constructing twin chemical and biological factories deep in the desert. Once American intelligence discovers the project, the President orders specialized Dragon Fire troops to destroy the facilities before they become operational. The mission must eliminate the threat before the factories can place the wider world in danger.

title: Operation Dragon Claw, Paperback
description:
A volcanic island. A devastating plan. An ocean of consequences.

A terrorist group invades the island of La Palma with a plan to place explosives along a crack in the Cumbre Vieja volcano. In the novel’s scenario, the resulting collapse would send an enormous mass of earth into the Atlantic and unleash a devastating tsunami. The Dragon Fire troops are dispatched to the island to stop the attack before its consequences reach far beyond the immediate battlefield.

title: Beyond Yesterday, Paperback
description:
To save the future, they must steal lives from the past.

After a nuclear exchange destroys most of the world’s population, survivors develop a way to reach into the past. Their first attempts to replenish humanity using reproductive material fail. They turn instead to taking people from earlier times, including the pilots of five aircraft that disappeared in the Bermuda Triangle. Each journey leaves consequences in the Atlantic, linking the mysteries of the past to a desperate effort to preserve the human future.

title: Code Cold Fire Alert, Paperback
description:
A containment failure. A lone colonel. The final safeguard.

The United States builds specialized plants to destroy its stockpiles of chemical and biological weapons. Crews are sealed inside for extended shifts, with orders to remain in place if a dangerous spill cannot be contained. When a spill occurs, doctors try to escape after disconnecting a nuclear sterilization device. A lone colonel enters the containment area to restore its power, knowing he may have to trigger the final safeguard by hand.

title: Trump’s Brass Escalator, Paperback
description:
A hostage crisis interrupts a mission to expose the truth.

Continuing the story of Sandstorm, this novel brings the President, Vice-President, Special Forces leader Walker, and his female sergeant to New York. They are preparing to present evidence gathered in Iran to the United Nations. Before they can do so, robbers attack Trump Tower and take the Vice-President hostage. Walker and his team must interrupt their larger mission to stop the robbery and save a life at the center of government.

title: Sandstorm, Paperback
description:
A covert mission into Iran to stop a nuclear threat.

A rogue Russian admiral sells Iran nuclear-tipped submarine-launched missiles. American special operations soldiers are sent into Iran to destroy the missiles and the submarines that carry them. They must also recover evidence of the transfer of weapons and technology—evidence that could expose how Iran acquired the means to build and launch its own nuclear threat against the United States.

title: Massive Vinegar Joe Platform, Paperback
description:
Across the Pacific, deception threatens a fragile balance of power.

China seeks United Nations approval for an attack on North Korea, presenting the operation as an effort to eliminate nuclear weapons. Behind that promise lies a broader deception involving Hong Kong and Taiwan. With no nearby military base available in the novel’s scenario, the United States turns to a massive floating platform as it responds to a growing confrontation in the Pacific.

The mission is over. The retaliation has only begun.

Walker and his Special Forces team must locate the new cell and stop its campaign of retaliation. The danger follows the soldiers home, turning the aftermath of one mission into the beginning of another.

title: Daughter of the Scorpion, Paperback
description:
One woman may know the location of a weapon that could end everything.

The discovery of secret military papers exposes an Iraqi biological weapons program. American intelligence learns that the pathogen could mutate and threaten life on a global scale if it is released. Captain Robert Walker leads an elite rapid response team into the Iraqi desert to find a young woman believed to know where the weapon is hidden. Time is running out as his soldiers race to locate the agent before its creator unleashes it.

title: Eagle’s Talon, Paperback
description:
An assassination plot. An elite team. A race into hostile territory.

Iraqi President Saddam Hussein sends a terrorist group to assassinate the American President in an effort to end the sanctions on his country. Special Forces leader Robert Walker and his troops are tasked with stopping the attack. Their mission then takes them into Iraq, where they must capture the terrorist leader and bring him to the United States to stand trial. This is the opening story of the Scorpion Trilogy.

title: Birth of Wind, Paperback
description:
In a world that denied her a place, she became a legend.

In Japan in 1333, a female samurai fights for her place in a society dominated by men. Her discipline, determination, and skill carry her through a life of conflict. When her story reaches its end, a curse placed on her sword by the shogun binds the warrior and the blade together for eternity. Birth of Wind begins a trilogy that carries her legacy across centuries.

The sword crosses an ocean. The warrior’s duty follows.

Wind’s sword is discovered once again, this time by the FBI. The agent responsible for it brings the blade back to the United States and soon learns that it is far more than an ordinary weapon. Wind remains bound to protect the person who possesses it, bringing the warrior’s enduring obligation into the agent’s life. The third novel carries the Wind Trilogy across the Pacific into a new setting.
